title: TP-03 and TP-04 ignition designation conflict

title: Fuel gas pressure reduction marked HOLD
detail: 30 bar to 3 bar pressure reducing unit is marked HOLD on ISO-02. Confirm approved assembly and installed condition.

title: API Pit vs API Separator nomenclature
detail: Isometric ISO-06 indicates API PIT (1)/(2) while P&ID uses API Separator. Confirm exact end locations.

title: No complete surveyed coordinates
detail: Available isometric and layout drawings do not establish a single surveyed plant coordinate system; route positions are placeholders pending matching as-built coordinates.

title: No job-specific ZEECO IOM SO 53475
detail: Manufacturer manuals relate to generic HEI and other FFG project SO 23052; use only for generic description.

title: Historical plot plan
detail: Site plan As-Built Dec 2008 predates package 2021-2022 and must not be treated as current survey.

title: Geometric centerline lengths not independently reconciled
detail: BOM pipe quantities are not literal line centerline lengths. 3D routes are conceptual and need dimension-by-dimension reconstruction.
